sources.title: d1-omni-600M - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Decision Models d1-omni-600M is a 587M parameter decision model built on LFM2.5-Encoder-350M with a SigLIP2-based vision encoder and audio encoder jointly fine-tuned for single-pass decisions.

sources.title: d1-omni-600M - 16k context, multimodal, open weights
sources.snippet: About d1-omni-600M is Liquid AI's open-weight ~587M edge decision model (post-trained from LFM2.5-Encoder-350M) with text+image or text+audio inputs. It returns typed noul/choice/score answers with zero output tokens. Context 16,384 tokens across modalities (with images, state+question text is cut to 896 tokens as trained).
